summary: Select Notes Trust LT 2004-1, a Delaware asset-backed trust sponsored by Structured Obligations Corporation and administered by U.S. Bank as trustee, filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an ordinary October 1, 2026 interest distribution to holders of its Long Term Certificates Series 2004-1 (CUSIP 81619PAF4). Interest received by the trust for the interest period commencing after September 1, 2026 totaled $101,250.00. The filing attaches the trustee's report and makes no recommendation and names no advisor. This is a routine periodic distribution notice, not a special situation; watch only underlying-security credit performance and distribution coverage.
